Outstanding Experience with Replace My Cage!

We recently had a custom pool cage built and installed by Replace My Cage, and we couldn’t be happier with the results. From start to finish, the process was smooth, professional, and efficient.

The new cage features massive Clear View panels with no-see-um screens, which not only look incredible but also keep even the tiniest bugs out—perfect for enjoying the outdoors without the hassle. One of the standout aspects of this project was the installation itself, which presented some challenges due to the elevated pool area. Despite that, the team handled everything with precision and skill.

Another major improvement over our old cage was the updated safety barrier. Instead of traditional vertical pickets, they installed sleek horizontal stainless steel cables that meet code requirements while giving the entire structure a much more modern, high-end feel. It's a small detail that made a huge difference in the overall appearance.

From the moment the permit was issued to the final walkthrough, the entire job was completed in just 30 days—an impressive timeline for a fully custom build. Communication was always clear and timely, and the workmanship speaks for itself.

On top of all that, the price was very competitive—especially considering the level of customization and quality we received. We truly feel we got excellent value for our investment.

Highly recommend Replace My Cage for anyone looking to upgrade their pool enclosure. This team delivers quality, professionalism, and a final product that truly enhances the space.

reviews.text: We worked with Replace My Cage and had a really great experience. We wanted a picture window that stretched roughly 60 feet and they were the only ones who had the 4x10 beam necessary to do that and pass engineering. We had a few other quotes and they all used an 4x8. Many of those companies told us not to go that far and that was primarily due to their lack of ability to produce the distance we wanted. Not two weeks after completion the cage was tested by Hurricane Milton and 130mph winds. We didn't lose a single screen and the structure unscathed. Many of our neighbors had complete loss of their cage. I've already recommended Dustin to many of my friends.

reviews.text: I had the pleasure of working with Dustin Keith from Replace My Cage, and I can’t express how pleased I am with the experience. After a year and a half of waiting for my pool cage with another company, I met Dustin while he was working on my neighbor’s project. To my surprise, he agreed to take on my project, promised completion within 2 weeks of permitting, and honored the original quote. In an industry overwhelmed since Hurricane Ian, Dustin’s commitment and communication were exceptional. Only four weeks after our initial meeting, I now enjoy a stunning pool cage. Dustin Keith is truly a man of his word, and I highly recommend Replace My Cage for their reliability and quality work.
